# Amazon Polly

Return fixture audio or deterministic placeholders and write synthesis task results to local S3.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `polly` |
| Signing name | `polly` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2016-06-10` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Fixture-backed local media, deterministic placeholders and S3 task outputs |
| Selected operations | 9 of 16 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-polly) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Plain text and the standard engine only; real synthesis, SSML, viseme marks, lexicon application, SNS notifications, and Opus, mu-law and a-law audio are unsupported.
- Task records are retained until reset; an interrupted task may leave its S3 output because task and S3 writes are separate.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `DeleteLexicon` | `DELETE /v1/lexicons/{Name}` |
| `DescribeVoices` | `GET /v1/voices` |
| `GetLexicon` | `GET /v1/lexicons/{Name}` |
| `GetSpeechSynthesisTask` | `GET /v1/synthesisTasks/{TaskId}` |
| `ListLexicons` | `GET /v1/lexicons` |
| `ListSpeechSynthesisTasks` | `GET /v1/synthesisTasks` |
| `PutLexicon` | `PUT /v1/lexicons/{Name}` |
| `StartSpeechSynthesisTask` | `POST /v1/synthesisTasks` |
| `SynthesizeSpeech` | `POST /v1/speech` |
